purpose: P-29 one-line kill pattern (ceiling x power grid): every frozen identity MUST complete this grid pre-PnL. Machine-fillable by the scorer; ceiling negative => VETO (K-COST) mechanically.
authority: plans/PLAN_dtp_cx_solusdt_c1.md §3 I002 + §4 F-5; plans/PLAN_daytrade_playbooks_program_v1.md §6.4 K-COST, §6.5 power floors, §7 cost law

inputs_required_per_identity.theta_gross_bps_per_RT: expected GROSS move capture per round trip, in bps — declared by the identity's definer BEFORE PnL, sha-pinned at freeze
inputs_required_per_identity.rt_cost_bps: round-trip cost from cost_book@draft ladder; in-window fills -> rt_1x/1_5x/2x measured ladder; out-window fills -> declared ladder; label FILL_QUALITY_CLASS_<measured|declared> on every row
inputs_required_per_identity.K_trades_planned: closed RT count the window can actually deliver (occupancy-based, not aspirational)

rt_cost_reference_bps.source: cost_book@draft.json rt_cost_ladder_taker_1m (fee 10 + 2x spread + 2x declared tick 0.5; funding add-on ~1e-4 bps expected, tail book separate)

arithmetic.veto_rule_K_COST: VETO pre-PnL if net_bps_per_RT <= 0 at ANY multiplier (strict form, plan I002: 'diffusion capture 1m phai >= ceiling o ca theta grid'); the minimal form (net_1x <= 0) is implied
arithmetic.power_rule: K < 100 closed RT => below power floor => INCONCLUSIVE, never PASS; child freeze pins its own n (>=100 floor; PF~1.3 reference n~236 per master §6.5); >=2 vol regimes occupancy floors (TWO-REGIME precedent 20/3/100)

example_row_I002_EXAMPLE_NOT_FROZEN.label: EXAMPLE-NOT-FROZEN — demonstrates the arithmetic only; theta is NOT frozen and this row carries no veto authority
example_row_I002_EXAMPLE_NOT_FROZEN.rt_cost_basis: declared RT 12.0 bps (mid of plan's 11-13 declared band; out-window declared ladder)
example_row_I002_EXAMPLE_NOT_FROZEN.grid_verdict: VETO_K_COST_STRICT (ceiling negative at 1.5x and 2.0x) — under the strict rule this theta dies pre-PnL; only theta >= 25 bps survives all three multipliers at this RT basis

fill_instructions_for_scorer: 1. Take theta_gross_bps_per_RT + K_trades_planned from the identity's frozen freeze artifact (sha-pinned).
2. Take rt_cost_bps from cost_book@draft.json ladder; choose in-window vs out-window per the fill timestamps actually simulated; stamp FILL_QUALITY_CLASS accordingly.
3. Evaluate net_bps_per_RT at mult in {1.0, 1.5, 2.0}; any net <= 0 => VETO_K_COST (terminal, pre-PnL).
4. Check K >= 100 (else INCONCLUSIVE) and occupancy/vol-regime floors; record both checks in the falsifier battery row (F-5).
5. Write the completed grid into the identity's falsifier battery artifact with the cost book sha256 pinned.
